title: Recover an AGV After It Loses a Tote (No Fault) Using RMS and Hospital HMI
summary: Recover from the “AGV LOST TOTE NO FAULT” condition by stopping RMS, physically moving the AGV to the Hospital, removing and re-adding the AGV via the Hospital station PC/HMI workflow, power-cycling the AGV, re-localizing it by rolling over the Inbound Hospital Station QR code, then locating/removing the missing tote and adding it back into the system so the AGV can return the tote to the sorter.
when_to_use: Use when an AGV has lost a tote but is in the “AGV LOST TOTE NO FAULT” recovery scenario, and you need to remove/re-add the AGV and re-localize it at the Inbound Hospital Station so the missing tote can be removed and reintroduced for normal sorter flow.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Executes the RMS stop, physical AGV handling (brake release and push to Hospital), Hospital station PC/HMI remove/add actions for the AGV and tote, and AGV power cycle + QR re-localization.
safety_notes: E-stop RMS as the first action in this recovery sequence.
access_or_tools_needed: Hospital station PC (used to remove/add AGV and remove/add tote via the referenced Hospital HMI workflows)

access_required: hospital_hmi access to use Hospital station workflows for Add/Remove AGV and Add/Remove Tote
system_preconditions: AGV is accessible on the floor for brake release and physical movement to the Hospital.
Inbound Hospital Station QR code is accessible for rolling the AGV over it after power cycle.

visual_references.description: Faulted AGV with Tote screen used as visual context for the recovery scenario (includes the recovery step list for AGV LOST TOTE NO FAULT).
Hospital HMI Add/Remove AGV screen (AGV ID field, Tote ID scanner, Call to Maintenance, Insert Into System).
Hospital HMI Add Tote screen (Tote ID and Barcode fields via green scanner; Confirm & Execute).
Hospital Station layout diagram showing induct/extract sides and green scanner location for tote handling.

steps.title: E-stop RMS
steps.purpose: Stop RMS fleet movement before physically handling the AGV and performing remove/re-add actions.
steps.instruction: On the RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui), perform the RMS E-stop action.
steps.expected_result: RMS is in an E-stopped state (E-stop control/status reflects the stopped condition on the RMS UI).
steps.healthy_condition: RMS remains stopped while you proceed with physical AGV handling and Hospital station remove/add steps.
steps.failure_condition: RMS continues running fleet movement while you attempt physical handling.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Section 5.8.2.6 'AGV LOST TOTE NO FAULT' step 1: 'E-stop the RMS.'

steps.title: Release the AGV brake
steps.purpose: Enable safe physical movement of the AGV that lost a tote.
steps.instruction: On the AGV that lost a tote, press the brake release.
steps.expected_result: The AGV brake is released, allowing the AGV to be pushed.
steps.healthy_condition: AGV can be moved without fighting the brake.
steps.failure_condition: AGV does not move as expected because the brake release did not take effect.

actions.label: Press brake release
actions.exact_action: Press the brake release on the AGV that lost a tote.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Section 5.8.2.6 'AGV LOST TOTE NO FAULT' step 2: 'Press the brake release on the AGV that lost a tote.'

steps.title: Push the AGV to the Hospital
steps.purpose: Move the AGV to the Hospital so it can be removed and re-added via the Hospital station PC/HMI workflow.
steps.instruction: Push the AGV over to the Hospital.
steps.expected_result: The AGV is physically positioned at the Hospital station area for the next remove/add step.
steps.healthy_condition: AGV is at the Hospital station area and ready for Hospital station PC/HMI remove/add actions.
steps.failure_condition: AGV cannot be positioned at the Hospital station area (e.g., blocked path).

actions.label: Push to Hospital
actions.exact_action: Push the AGV over to the Hospital.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Section 5.8.2.6 'AGV LOST TOTE NO FAULT' step 3: 'Push the AGV over to the Hospital.'

steps.title: Remove and re-add the AGV at the Hospital station PC/HMI
steps.purpose: Clear the AGV from the system and reintroduce it so it can be re-localized at the Inbound Hospital Station.
steps.instruction: At the Hospital station PC, remove the AGV from the system, then add the AGV back into the system using the Hospital station PC workflow/HMI.
steps.expected_result: The AGV is removed and then inserted back into the system via the Hospital station PC/HMI workflow.
steps.healthy_condition: Hospital HMI workflow completes the remove and insert actions for the specific AGV ID you are recovering.
steps.failure_condition: Hospital HMI remove/add actions do not complete for the AGV ID (AGV not accepted back into the system).

actions.label: Remove AGV
actions.exact_action: At the Hospital station PC, remove the AGV from the system.

actions.label: Add AGV back
actions.exact_action: Then, add the AGV back into the system.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Section 5.8.2.6 'AGV LOST TOTE NO FAULT' step 4: 'At the Hospital station PC, remove the AGV. Then, add the AGV back into the system.'
Figure 4-37 'Hospital HMI Add/Remove AGV Screen' includes 'AGV ID' input, 'Call to Maintenance' and 'Insert Into System' buttons; note: only maintenance or a supervisor should remove an AGV.

steps.title: Power-cycle the AGV
steps.purpose: Reset AGV state so it can become ready (green lights) for QR re-localization.
steps.instruction: Turn the AGV off, then turn it on again.
steps.expected_result: AGV has been turned off and then back on.
steps.healthy_condition: AGV begins its startup sequence after power on.
steps.failure_condition: AGV does not restart or does not proceed to the expected green-light ready state.

actions.label: Power off/on
actions.exact_action: Turn the AGV off, then turn it on again.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Section 5.8.2.6 'AGV LOST TOTE NO FAULT' step 5: 'Turn the AGV off, then turn it on again.'

steps.title: Wait for AGV lights to turn green
steps.purpose: Confirm the AGV is ready for QR re-localization.
steps.instruction: Wait for the AGV lights to turn green.
steps.healthy_condition: AGV lights are green, indicating ready/operational status after the power cycle.
steps.failure_condition: AGV lights do not turn green after the power cycle.

actions.label: Verify green lights
actions.exact_action: Wait for the AGV lights to turn green.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the AGV does not show green lights after the power cycle.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Section 5.8.2.6 'AGV LOST TOTE NO FAULT' step 6: 'When the AGV lights turn green, roll it over the QR code in front of the Inbound Hospital Station.'

steps.title: Re-localize by rolling over the Inbound Hospital Station QR code
steps.purpose: Re-localize the AGV at the Inbound Hospital Station so it can proceed with tote recovery/removal.
steps.instruction: Roll the AGV over the QR code in front of the Inbound Hospital Station.
steps.expected_result: AGV has been rolled over the Inbound Hospital Station QR code after lights turned green.
steps.healthy_condition: AGV successfully re-localizes after rolling over the QR code.
steps.failure_condition: AGV does not successfully re-localize after rolling over the Inbound Hospital QR code.

actions.label: Roll over QR
actions.exact_action: Roll the AGV over the QR code in front of the Inbound Hospital Station.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the AGV does not successfully re-localize after rolling over the Inbound Hospital QR code.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Section 5.8.2.6 'AGV LOST TOTE NO FAULT' step 6: 'When the AGV lights turn green, roll it over the QR code in front of the Inbound Hospital Station.'

steps.title: Locate and remove the missing tote at the Hospital
steps.purpose: Remove the missing tote from the system so it can be reintroduced correctly.
steps.instruction: Locate the missing tote and bring it to the Hospital to remove it from the system.
steps.expected_result: The missing tote is located and removed from the system via the Hospital station workflow.
steps.healthy_condition: Tote removal is completed for the missing tote at the Hospital station.
steps.failure_condition: Missing tote cannot be located, or cannot be removed from the system via the Hospital station PC/HMI controls.

actions.label: Locate missing tote
actions.exact_action: Locate the missing tote and bring it to the Hospital to remove it from the system.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the missing tote cannot be located or cannot be removed/added via the Hospital station PC/HMI controls.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Section 5.8.2.6 'AGV LOST TOTE NO FAULT' step 7: 'Locate the missing tote and bring it to the Hospital to remove it from the system.'

steps.title: Add the tote back into the system
steps.purpose: Reintroduce the tote so normal sorter flow can resume.
steps.instruction: Add the tote back into the system using the Hospital station PC workflow/HMI.
steps.expected_result: The tote is added back into the system via the Hospital station workflow.
steps.healthy_condition: Tote add action completes successfully for the tote you removed.
steps.failure_condition: Tote cannot be added back into the system via the Hospital station PC/HMI controls.

actions.label: Add tote
actions.exact_action: Add the tote back into the system.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the missing tote cannot be located or cannot be removed/added via the Hospital station PC/HMI controls.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Section 5.8.2.6 'AGV LOST TOTE NO FAULT' step 8: 'Add the tote back into the system.'
Figure 4-31 'Hospital HMI Add Tote Screen' includes Tote ID and Barcode fields populated using the green scanner and a 'CONFIRM & EXECUTE' button to send the tote back into the system.

success_criteria: After AGV lights turn green and the AGV is rolled over the Inbound Hospital Station QR code, the missing tote is removed from the system and then successfully added back.
The AGV then takes the tote back to the sorter.
healthy_conditions: AGV lights are green after power cycle.
AGV successfully re-localizes after rolling over the Inbound Hospital Station QR code.
Missing tote is removed from the system and then added back successfully via Hospital station workflows.
failure_conditions: AGV does not show green lights after the power cycle.
AGV does not successfully re-localize after rolling over the Inbound Hospital Station QR code.
Missing tote cannot be located or cannot be removed/added via the Hospital station PC/HMI controls.
escalation_guidance: Stop and escalate if the AGV does not show green lights after the power cycle.
Stop and escalate if the AGV does not successfully re-localize after rolling over the Inbound Hospital QR code.
Stop and escalate if the missing tote cannot be located or cannot be removed/added via the Hospital station PC/HMI controls.
